title: Sign in
intro: No password needed. We'll email you a code and a sign-in link.

check-email.title: Check your email
check-email.sent: We sent a 6-digit code and a sign-in link to {email}. Enter the code here, or click the link in the email.
check-email.resent: New code sent. Use the code from the newest email.
check-email.spam: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder. The code and link work once and expire in 10 minutes.

link.invalid-title: This sign-in link doesn't work anymore
link.invalid: Links work once and expire after 10 minutes. Enter your email and we'll send you a new one.
link.sent: We sent a new code and link to {email}.

errors.invalid-code: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
errors.expired-code: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.
errors.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.passkey: Signing in with a passkey didn't work. Try again, or use your email.
